newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH BONDS END ABOUT FLAT ON U.S. DATA.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH BONDS END ABOUT FLAT ON U.S. DATA.

text.p: * Slightly below forecast U.S. July retail sales data and a
fall in U.S. PPI help Finnish bonds close flat to a shade firmer
on Wednesday, after woes ahead of the data dragged prices
earlier, dealers say. Very thin trade.
* Gap over Bunds steady just above 20 bp, seen rangebound as
focus turns to U.S. CPI on Thursday, domestic auction of 2004
bonds on Thursday and Finnish CPI on Friday.
* DEM/FIM rises early on mark recovery after Buba inflation
report, but meets resistance at 2.9950, dealers say.
